_note: Final thesis item F4.3 - load stations: A AGV P&D station, B TU1 check station, C pick / rework station Z31, D gravity flow racks for the line-side buffers, E HMC pallet load station. DESIGN values / REFERENCE ESTIMATES; catalogue classes [verify]. Tool: load_stations.py. Guide: Doctor paper/61 chapters 22-33.

pd._agv: AGV docking accuracy (natural-contour / reflector navigation with final docking sensor) - requirement handed to F5
pd._step: a runner can roll over a height step h onto a roller of diameter D if h <= ~0.1 D (60 mm roller -> 6 mm)
pd._buffer: polyurethane end buffers: the crate hits the stop only if the stop sensor fails (control fault) - KE absorbed within the stroke; content shift starts at about 0.5 g

handshake: AGV stands docked (docking sensor + position confirmed by the fleet manager)
AGV deck loaded, ready to push the crate out (drop-off)
AGV deck empty, rollers running inwards (pick-up)
crate fully on / off the AGV deck (deck sensors)
first lane zone empty, lane rollers running inwards, end stop lowered (drop-off)
crate at the lane end, stop lowered, rollers running outwards (pick-up)
crate fully on the lane / fully off the lane (zone sensors)
station fault / E-stop / light curtain without muting -> AGV stops its rollers
_handshake_note: parallel signals over a short-range optical data coupler at the docking point (8 bit each way, deterministic, independent of Wi-Fi); job data (crate id, destination) over the fleet manager / fmsctl. The safety stop does NOT use these signals (item F8).

check._detect: smallest object that must be detected when it sticks out (crankshaft end ~20 mm, bolt heads)
check._class: OIML R60 C3-class load cell: combined error ~0.023 % of capacity per cell (simplified) [verify]
check._h: total crate height 600 mm including the 160 mm runners (F3 / F4.2)

kit._heavy: parts heavier than this are NOT kitted: they go to assembly in their own crate (line feeding) and are handled with balancers there
kit._t: MTM-UAS-style values: fixed = crate arrival, scan, pick-to-light confirm; per pick = reach, grasp, move, place in the kit trolley compartment; bin = pull a far bin to the near side

cases: pick from a near bin, top layer
pick from a near bin, bottom layer
pick from a FAR bin without pulling it
lift a full bin (15 kg) out of the top layer to the side shelf
niosh._cases: [name, H cm, V cm, D cm, FM]; FM from the revised NIOSH table: 6 lifts/min 1-2 h -> 0.50; 0.5 lifts/min 1-2 h -> 0.92 [verify table]

kit._niosh: cases: [name, H cm (horizontal distance hands - ankles), V cm (hand height at origin), D cm (vertical travel)]
kit._bins: VDA RL-KLT 6147 class 600 x 400 x 147.5: 2 layers x 4 fit the crate inside 1192 x 792 x 420 mm

flow._note: pallet-flow lanes, crate 1200-leading on rollers 60 x 2 at pitch 150; entry at the AGV side (AGV deck rollers push the crate in), exit at the machine side with a pallet separator; one lane per part type (FIFO), one empty-crate return lane per department (opposite slope)
flow._lane_w: crate 800 across + 2 x 70 frame + 2 x 55 clearance
flow._entry: the AGV lifting deck raises the crate to 900 mm at the flow-lane entry (requirement F5: deck lift 700-900 mm); the lane drops s x L to the exit
flow._return: empties: at the exit the crate in use stands on a ball-transfer deck across the lanes of the department; the operator slides the empty crate (45 kg) sideways to the entry of a POWERED return lane (2 roller zones) that climbs gently to the AGV deck height 700

hmc._lc: light curtain between the operator side and the pallet-shuttle side: the shuttle (F2 transport 0.5 min per move) must be stopped before a hand / body reaches it; K = 1600 mm/s (body approach, ISO 13855), stop time of the shuttle axis (design)
hmc._positions: [part, raw kg, machined kg, clamping positions on the tombstone]; one handling per position per visit = unload the old part + load the new one (F1 load model); FA one-in-one-out: OP10 + OP20 positions
hmc._slew: slewing ring class Ø 300 four-point contact: much stronger than needed (fs > 20); chosen for tilting stiffness of the table under hoist impacts and for the index accuracy, a smaller ring is not cheaper in this size
